meta.scope: read-only audit of artifacts/autoresearch; no file modified, no radio contacted
meta.method: seven ordered rules, explicit field first, then live, negative, simulation, measurement payload, static; anything left is undeclared
premise_corrections: the first pass reported 371 undeclared receipts because the rules expected status metadata, while the live autoresearch runs carry a measurement payload instead
a filename that encodes a distance and a loss is not evidence; the numeric payload inside the receipt is

gaps: a label states the provenance of a receipt, not the correctness of its conclusion
measurement payload is evidence that numbers were produced by a run, not that the run was instrumented correctly
the audit reads receipts only, so a receipt that lies about its own payload passes
the 12 previously unreadable receipts from other workstreams are counted separately and are not classified

publication_redaction.original_source_bindings: require private originals; derivative is not original evidence
